newsitem.title: USA: Quickturn Design stake cut by Vinik group.
newsitem.headline: Quickturn Design stake cut by Vinik group.

text.p: A group including Vinik Asset Management L.P. and former Fidelity Investment Funds manager Jerffery Vinik said Thursday it cut its stake in Quickturn Design Systems Inc 678,500 common, or 4.8 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 153,500 common sold between December 9 and December with prices ranging from $18.75 to $21.6704 per share.
The group previously held a 5.9 percent stake in the Mountain View, Calif company, or 832,000 common shares. Quickturn is a semiconductor design automation firm.
